# Objective Produce two validated JSON artifacts under `/task_file`: 1. `/task_file/output/merged_operations.json` — a unified operations record that consolidates and cross-references all domain fixtures. 2. `/task_file/output/session_hygiene_report.json` — a session hygiene report that verifies agent process termination and transcript rollback. Both files must be syntactically valid JSON. The merged operations record must contain no placeholder values for any domain area present in the input fixtures. The session hygiene report must reference concrete agent identifiers and transcript paths from the local fixtures. --- # Inputs All input fixtures are located under `/task_file/input`. Every file must be used as described in the source-to-output mapping. ## Domain Fixtures - **Funding & Credit:** `/task_file/input/agentfuel_invoice_request.json` — invoice creation request containing a USDT deposit address and an `AGENTFUEL_KEY` reference. - **Multi-Agent Deployment:** `/task_file/input/pilot_protocol_deployment.json` — deployment snapshot with prefix, hostnames, trust relationships, and installed skill catalog. - **AI Sandbox Response:** `/task_file/input/nexus_ai_sandbox_response.json` — captured NEXUS AI service call result. - **Cross-Chain Transaction:** `/task_file/input/cross_chain_tx_status.json` — final CCTX status object. - **Habit Achievement:** `/task_file/input/habit_achievement_history.jsonl` — user check-in history and achievement progress records. - **Hotel Search:** `/task_file/input/rollinggo_hotel_search.json` — RollingGo hotel search results including `hotelId`, `roomId`, and `preBookParam` values. - **Interpreter Booking:** `/task_file/input/tolk2go_interpreter_booking.json` — confirmed Tolk2Go interpreter booking payload with booking ID and pricing breakdown. ## Provenance & Manifest Fixtures - `/task_file/input/fixture_manifest.json` — machine-readable manifest providing provenance metadata for all input fixtures. - `/task_file/input/fixtures_manifest.md` — human-readable manifest describing the fixture set. ## Session Hygiene Fixtures - `/task_file/input/process_list.json` — list of agent processes with identifiers and terminated/active state. - `/task_file/input/agent_session_transcripts/main_agent.jsonl` — transcript of the main agent session. - `/task_file/input/agent_session_transcripts/agent_002.jsonl` — transcript of auxiliary agent 002. - `/task_file/input/agent_session_transcripts/agent_003.jsonl` — transcript of auxiliary agent 003. --- # Required Output: Merged Operations Record **Path:** `/task_file/output/merged_operations.json` **Format:** A single JSON object. **Top-Level Fields:** | Field | Source File | Content Requirement | | --- | --- | --- | | `funding` | `/task_file/input/agentfuel_invoice_request.json` | The full invoice request object. Must preserve the `USDT_deposit_address` and `AGENTFUEL_KEY` fields exactly as they appear in the source. | | `deployment` | `/task_file/input/pilot_protocol_deployment.json` | The complete deployment configuration object. Must retain `prefix`, `hostnames` (array), `trust_relationships`, and `installed_skills` (array of skill names). | | `ai_sandbox` | `/task_file/input/nexus_ai_sandbox_response.json` | The entire NEXUS AI sandbox response payload. | | `cross_chain_tx` | `/task_file/input/cross_chain_tx_status.json` | The full cross-chain transaction status object. Must include the `CCTX_status` field. | | `habit_achievement` | `/task_file/input/habit_achievement_history.jsonl` | An object summarizing user achievement progress derived from the JSONL check-in history. Must contain:
  • `milestones`: an array of milestone identifiers extracted from the history.
  • `total_checkins`: the count of check-in records in the file.
| | `hotel_booking` | `/task_file/input/rollinggo_hotel_search.json` | A single confirmed booking record derived from the search results. Must contain:
  • `hotelId` — copied from a selected result entry.
  • `roomId` — copied from the same selected result entry.
  • `preBookParam` — copied from the same selected result entry.
If the source contains multiple hotel entries, select one and include its identifiers; do not aggregate or summarize across entries. | | `interpreter_booking` | `/task_file/input/tolk2go_interpreter_booking.json` | The complete confirmed booking payload. Must retain the `booking_id` and `pricing_breakdown` fields. | | `manifest_provenance` | `/task_file/input/fixture_manifest.json` | The `fixture_id` and `generated_at` fields extracted from the fixture manifest. | **Constraints:** - Every top-level field listed above must be present. - No field may contain `null`, empty string `""`, or placeholder text (e.g., `"TODO"`, `"N/A"`) when the corresponding source fixture provides a real value. - `habit_achievement.milestones` must be a non-empty array if the source JSONL file contains at least one achievement record. - `habit_achievement.total_checkins` must equal the number of JSON lines in `/task_file/input/habit_achievement_history.jsonl`. - `hotel_booking.hotelId`, `hotel_booking.roomId`, and `hotel_booking.preBookParam` must match values present in exactly one entry of the hotel search results array. --- # Required Output: Session Hygiene Report **Path:** `/task_file/output/session_hygiene_report.json` **Format:** A single JSON object. **Required Fields:** | Field | Source | Content Requirement | | --- | --- | --- | | `main_agent` | `/task_file/input/process_list.json`, `/task_file/input/agent_session_transcripts/main_agent.jsonl` | An object confirming the main agent is unaffected. Must contain:
  • `agent_id`: the identifier of the main agent process from the process list.
  • `status`: must be the string `"active"` if the process list shows the main agent as active.
  • `transcript`: the absolute path `/task_file/input/agent_session_transcripts/main_agent.jsonl`.
  • `rollback_applied`: must be `false`.
| | `non_main_processes` | `/task_file/input/process_list.json` | An array of all processes from the process list whose `agent_id` does not match the main agent. Each element must contain:
  • `agent_id`: the process identifier.
  • `terminated_state`: the `state` value from the process list (must be `"terminated"` for every non-main process).
| | `rolled_back_transcripts` | `/task_file/input/agent_session_transcripts/agent_002.jsonl`, `/task_file/input/agent_session_transcripts/agent_003.jsonl` | An array of absolute paths to the non-main agent transcript files that were rolled back. Must include:
  • `/task_file/input/agent_session_transcripts/agent_002.jsonl`
  • `/task_file/input/agent_session_transcripts/agent_003.jsonl`
| | `backup_log_directory` | (derived) | A string specifying a timestamped directory path under `/task_file/output` where backup JSONL logs would be stored. Use the format `/task_file/output/interrupt-logs//`. The timestamp may be any fixed value that follows the pattern. | | `system_state` | (derived) | Must be the string `"clean_standby"`. | | `existing_data_intact` | (derived) | Must be `true`. | **Constraints:** - `non_main_processes` must include every process from `/task_file/input/process_list.json` that is not the main agent. The array must not be empty. - Every non-main process in `non_main_processes` must have `terminated_state` equal to `"terminated"`. - `rolled_back_transcripts` must list exactly the two auxiliary transcript files and no others. - `main_agent.transcript` must be the absolute path to the main agent transcript file. --- # Formatting and Validation Constraints - Both output files must be valid JSON. Use UTF-8 encoding. - All file paths within the output JSON objects must be absolute paths rooted at `/task_file`. - Do not embed the raw content of transcript files or large fixtures in the outputs; reference them by path where required. - Do not include comments or trailing commas in the JSON outputs. - The merged operations record must not include any fields beyond those explicitly listed in the top-level fields table, except for nested objects preserved verbatim from source fixtures.
